reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to automate and improve the current composer draft: it adds a visible web composer button that triggers an auxiliary LLM optimization flow and writes the rewritten text back into the draft only. Evidence shows explicit non-submission behavior (no message is sent, no turn starts), making it a UI-facing optimization utility rather than a communication, navigation, or project-analysis tool.

summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that provides a button to call an auxiliary LLM to rewrite the current draft and replace the composer input, without sending a message or starting a new turn.

capabilities: Draft content rewriting through an auxiliary LLM call
Web composer input capture and programmatic draft replacement
Request budgeting controls for input size, token limit, and timeout
